description: Weekly US refrigerated (reefer) truckload spot rates per lane from USDA AMS Market News via USDA AgTransport open data: origin shipping district, destination city (10 major US cities), miles, week low/high/midpoint USD per load, USD per mile and truck availability (1 surplus to 5 shortage). Produce lanes only; not DAT van/flatbed load-board data. Published weekly. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

destination.description: Optional destination city: ATLANTA, BALTIMORE, BOSTON, CHICAGO, DALLAS, LOS ANGELES, MIAMI, NEW YORK, PHILADELPHIA, SEATTLE

origin.description: Optional text inside the origin district name, e.g. SALINAS

region.description: Optional origin region: ARIZONA, CALIFORNIA, FLORIDA, GREAT LAKES, MEXICO-ARIZONA, MEXICO-TEXAS, MID-ATLANTIC, NEW YORK, PNW, SOUTHEAST
